title: ID0452245-DC/Si-D/FR- [Y2 / PN 312569868/06] Faulted charging points
description:
Reported behavior/issue:  I’m following up regarding this charging station. You intervened on
it on 19/09/25 to replace a converter. I noticed on 22/09 that the
station was showing a fault on both charging points. I discussed it
on Monday with Sébastien, who was supposed to get back to me.
Conflicting information is coming up on SCB and our backend:
- SCB: Two routers are connected, but both charging points are in
fault. The error flags are not displayed.
- Greenflux: Both charging points report “router1 connection loss”
and “SECC is initializing.”
